reasoning: Data Connect Hub is a Rust workspace described as a middleware service that is the single place to ingest data from many kinds of data sources (S3, PostgreSQL, Milvus, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, SQLite, URI). Its main deliverables are two runnable service binaries: services/flight (an Arrow Flight gRPC service) and services/rest (an HTTP REST service). Both store their metadata in PostgreSQL. The connectors/* and libs/* crates are internal libraries used by those services, and sdk/python is a client SDK. The repo also includes dc-controller, a Go kubebuilder operator (API v1alpha1) that deploys and manages the rest and flight services. However, the .tekton pipelines for this release (rhoai-3.7-ea.1) build only the flight and rest service images, and config/ holds Kustomize deployment manifests for those services. So the main artifact is a deployable data-access service, and the operator is a secondary deployment helper.
